title: Run at Startup
author: rickmaca-collab
summary: PowerToys intermittently fails to start at logon despite Run at startup being enabled, noticed when FancyZones is absent.
next_action: Consolidate into issue 23193 and keep FancyZones out of the root-cause classification.

confidence.rationale: The report explicitly describes whole-app absence and matches the open canonical tracker.

judgment.rationale: The symptom is the same whole-app startup failure tracked by open issue 23193 and duplicated in the newer 47161 thread; FancyZones is only how the reporter notices PowerToys did not start.
evidence: The report says the PowerToys tray icon is absent and the app must be started manually.
Two Windows 11 25H2 Store users confirm the same intermittent behavior.
Issue 23193 remains open as the general startup tracker.
Issue 47161 explicitly cross-links the same symptom to 23193.
judgment.recommended_action: Consolidate into issue 23193 and keep FancyZones out of the root-cause classification.

fix_assessment.rationale: This is a duplicate startup report, not a distinct FancyZones code defect.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys intermittently fails to start at logon despite Run at startup being enabled, noticed when FancyZones is absent.
known_information: The app starts only intermittently at logon.
inferences: The module symptom is downstream of PowerToys not running.
issue_context.analysis: Consolidation gives maintainers one place to compare startup-registration and process-exit evidence.
initial_investigation: Compared the live thread with issue 47161 and the previous dashboard classification.

actions.label: Consolidate with startup tracker 23193

comment.body: This is the same whole-app startup symptom tracked in #23193: PowerToys is configured to run at startup but is intermittently absent after logon and must be launched manually. FancyZones is how the failure is noticed, not a separate FancyZones startup path. Please consolidate the Windows 11 25H2 / Store confirmations into #23193.
